headline: Rupee falls 14 paise to close near all-time  low level at 94.82 against US dollar
summary: The rupee fell 14 paise to close near its all-time low of 94.82 against the US dollar, pressured by Brent crude hovering around $115 a barrel and continued foreign capital outflows.
why: The rupee's value affects India's import bill, inflation and the returns of foreign investors in Indian assets.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Brent crude near $115 a barrel raises India's oil import costs and pressures the currency.
